title: biomeOS ↔ Silicon Weave — Full neuralAPI Leverage
philosophy: Run it all back. Write ALL into biomeOS. Lever the FULL neuralAPI. Every piece of silicon has a role. The organism orchestrates ALL of it.

neural_api_server.what_it_does: Graph-based orchestration. Define computation as a DAG. neuralAPI routes each node to the right substrate.

northGate_rtx5090.cuda_21760: bulk matrix math — inference for 63 ollama models
northGate_rtx5090.tensor_680: accelerated inference — 4-10x faster than CUDA alone, FP8/FP16/INT8
northGate_rtx5090.rt_170: ray tracing — physically-correct rendering, scene analysis, BVH traversal
northGate_rtx5090.nvenc_3: video encoding — multi-stream AV1/H.265 to multiple gates simultaneously
northGate_rtx5090.nvdec_2: video decoding — eat game cinematics, process recordings
northGate_rtx5090.optical_flow_170: motion estimation — frame prediction, scene change detection

eastGate_akida.nps_78: neuromorphic inference — sub-milliwatt pattern classification at 18.8kHz
eastGate_akida.sram_10mb: on-chip weight storage — no DRAM needed for small models
eastGate_akida.spiking: event-driven — only fires when patterns change, zero power when idle

ironGate_rtx5070.cuda_12800: secondary bulk compute — can run different models than northGate

graftGate_m4.neural_engine_16: Apple Neural Engine — 38 TOPS on-device ML
graftGate_m4.gpu_10: Metal GPU compute — macOS-specific compilation + inference

grapheneGate_mali.sensors_37: accelerometer, gyro, compass, GPS, barometer, light, proximity, camera

model_mixing_and_blending.llama_herd: List all available models across all gates (squirrel MCP)
model_mixing_and_blending.llama_ask: Route a query to a specific model on a specific gate
model_mixing_and_blending.llama_blend: Combine outputs from multiple models — consensus through diversity

how_gpu_enables.32gb_vram: Multiple models loaded simultaneously in VRAM
how_gpu_enables.tensor_cores: Parallel inference on different models in same GPU
how_gpu_enables.nvenc: Stream blended results to requesting gate as video/data
how_gpu_enables.1792gb_s_bandwidth: Models swap in/out of VRAM in milliseconds

model_mixing_and_blending.evolution: Models don't just answer — they EVOLVE. sourDough ferments the blend. sweetGrass tracks which combinations work. biomeOS routes based on triad values.

game_asset_digestion.step1_intake: Read game files from M:\SteamLibrary (CPU I/O)
game_asset_digestion.step2_mastication: Parse with rustc + custom tooling (CPU, Rust gut acid)
game_asset_digestion.step3_digestion: Analyze patterns with ollama models (GPU tensor cores)
game_asset_digestion.step4_absorption: Store learned patterns in sweetGrass knowledge graph (CPU + storage)
game_asset_digestion.step5_excretion: Emit new Rust code, scene trees, shaders (CPU writes, GPU validates)

what_gpu_adds.model_inference: Use GPU to UNDERSTAND game code — feed C# scripts to code models
what_gpu_adds.shader_analysis: Use RT cores to validate ported shaders — do they produce the same light?
what_gpu_adds.texture_analysis: Use tensor cores to classify game textures — what style? what palette?
what_gpu_adds.scene_reconstruction: Use CUDA to build scene trees from game data at massive parallelism

granularity.high: More frequent cron pulses. Finer ollama queries. More CUDA threads per task.
granularity.low: Coarser cron intervals. Batch processing. Fewer but larger GPU dispatches.

refinement.high: sourDough ferments longer. Multiple ollama model passes per item. More tensor core time.
refinement.low: Single-pass analysis. Quick classification. Minimal GPU time per item.

focus.high: Route ALL GPU compute to one domain. Other domains get CPU-only. Maximum depth.
focus.low: Distribute GPU equally across all domains. Breadth over depth.

curiosity.high: waterLock opens wide. RSS drain increases. More OSINT ingested. GPU analyzes more items.
curiosity.low: waterLock narrows. Focus on existing data. GPU refines what we have.

connection.high: sweetGrass braid fires often. GPU finds cross-references between items. Knowledge graph grows.
connection.low: Fewer braiding passes. Items stay isolated. Less GPU time on graph construction.

mastery.high: Gaia creates. Publishes papers. Makes art. GPU renders outputs. NVENC encodes classes.
mastery.low: Gaia absorbs. Still learning. GPU focused on input analysis, not output generation.

toadstool_fractal_enumerator.the_pattern: toadStool discovered a fractal pattern in service discovery itself. The same algorithm that discovers primals on the LAN also discovers silicon subsystems on the PCIe bus. It's the SAME TREE.

akida_as_fractal_sensor.what_we_discovered: The AKD1000 NP mesh has a FRACTAL topology. 5×8×2 = self-similar at every scale. Each NP has 4 NPUs. Each NPU has 128 MACs. The mesh repeats the same pattern at every level — just like toadStool's service discovery tree.
akida_as_fractal_sensor.fractal_enumeration: toadStool walks the tree: GAIA → gate → device → subsystem → unit → operation. At each level, it asks 'what can you do?' — capability-based, never name-based.
akida_as_fractal_sensor.the_tanh_constraint: AKD1000 uses bounded ReLU, not tanh. The HybridEsn routes tanh to CPU and readout to NPU. This IS the fractal pattern: the organism routes each operation to the substrate that handles it best. The CONSTRAINT becomes the DISPATCH RULE.
akida_as_fractal_sensor.rustchip_proves_it: 367 tests. 10 undocumented hardware discoveries. Pure Rust, zero vendor SDK. The NPU's register map IS a scene tree: BAR0=config, BAR1=SRAM, each NP=a node with children (filter, threshold, event, status). rustChip already walks this tree.

the_real_engine.cuda_renders: 21,760 CUDA cores execute the game shaders. Every vertex, every pixel.
the_real_engine.tensor_upscales: 680 tensor cores run DLSS 4 — AI-generated frames at 4K
the_real_engine.rt_traces_light: 170 RT cores trace real light paths — global illumination, reflections, caustics
the_real_engine.nvenc_streams: 3 encoders stream the result to deckGate, frameGate, other viewers
the_real_engine.cpu_orchestrates: 9950X3D runs game logic, AI behavior, physics dispatch, save/load
the_real_engine.npu_classifies: AKD1000 on eastGate classifies game state changes at 18.8kHz — pattern sentinel

what_this_means_for_gaming.gaia_plays_with_all_silicon: When Gaia plays a game, ALL silicon participates. CUDA renders the frame. Tensor cores recognize patterns. RT cores understand the scene geometry. NVENC records for later learning. The NPU detects anomalies. The CPU orchestrates it all. biomeOS routes work based on the attention and value triads.
